rows.label: Passenger pigeon
rows.description: extinct species of North American pigeon, most abundant bird on Earth before extinction
rows.hook: was once among the most numerous birds in North America before hunting wiped it out

rows.label: Chicken
rows.description: domesticated bird (specifically a red junglefowl) kept by humans primarily as a food source
rows.hook: is raised on farms around the world for its eggs and meat

rows.label: Dodo
rows.description: species of extinct bird native to Mauritius Island
rows.hook: was a flightless island native that vanished soon after sailors arrived

rows.label: Peregrine falcon
rows.hook: is the fastest animal on Earth, reaching huge speeds in a hunting dive

rows.label: Kakapo
rows.description: species of non-flying New Zealand parrot
rows.hook: is a heavy, nocturnal, flightless parrot that booms at night to attract mates

rows.label: Bald eagle
rows.description: species of bird of prey found in North America
rows.hook: is the national emblem of the United States, with a white head and tail

rows.label: Hummingbird
rows.hook: hovers in mid-air and can even fly backwards while sipping nectar

rows.label: Osprey
rows.hook: dives feet-first into water to snatch fish, often nesting on poles

rows.label: Shoebill
rows.hook: is a giant swamp dweller with an enormous clog-shaped beak

rows.label: Golden eagle
rows.hook: is a huge, dark-brown mountain hunter prized by falconers

rows.label: Cassowary
rows.description: genus of flightless birds including three species of cassowary. Native to the New Guinea forests, the Moluccas, and Northeastern Australia
rows.hook: has a bony crest and dagger-like claws that can seriously injure people

rows.label: Harpy eagle
rows.hook: is a huge rainforest hunter of Central and South America that plucks sloths and monkeys from trees

rows.label: Emu
rows.hook: is Australia's tallest native bird and appears on its coat of arms

rows.label: Pigeon
rows.hook: is the city dweller once used to carry messages over long distances

rows.label: Blue jay
rows.hook: is a noisy, crested bird of eastern North America that gave its name to a Toronto baseball team

rows.label: Albatross
rows.description: large seabirds allied to the procellariids, storm-petrels and diving-petrels in the order Procellariiformes
rows.hook: has the longest wingspan of any seabird and glides over open water for hours

rows.label: Budgerigar
rows.hook: is a small, popular pet that can learn to repeat human speech

rows.label: Canada goose
rows.hook: migrates in V-shaped flocks across North America and is common in city parks

rows.label: Raven
rows.hook: is a large, clever black bird of legend, kept at the Tower of London

rows.label: Great auk
rows.hook: was a flightless North Atlantic seabird hunted to extinction

rows.label: House sparrow
rows.hook: is a small brown bird that lives alongside people in cities worldwide

rows.label: Great horned owl
rows.hook: has feathery ear-like tufts and a deep hooting call across the Americas

rows.label: Roadrunner
rows.hook: is a fast-running desert cuckoo that outsmarts Wile E. Coyote in cartoons

rows.label: Secretarybird
rows.description: large, mostly terrestrial bird of prey
rows.hook: is a long-legged African hunter that stomps on snakes

rows.label: Turkey vulture
rows.hook: soars on warm air currents and finds its carrion meals by smell

rows.label: Mallard
rows.hook: is the most familiar wild duck, the male sporting a glossy green head

rows.label: Emperor penguin
rows.description: large flightless seabird endemic to Antarctica
rows.hook: huddles through the Antarctic winter while males balance the egg on their feet

rows.label: Northern cardinal
rows.hook: is a bright red crested singer that is the state symbol of several US states

rows.label: Kookaburra
rows.hook: is known for a loud call that sounds like human laughter

rows.label: Mourning dove
rows.hook: has a soft, sad-sounding coo and is among North America's most common birds

rows.label: Red-tailed hawk
rows.hook: is the common soaring hunter seen perched along North American highways

rows.label: Andean condor
rows.hook: is a huge South American scavenger that soars over mountains on enormous wings

rows.label: Kingfisher
rows.hook: is a small, vivid bird that dives headfirst into streams to catch fish

rows.label: Great blue heron
rows.hook: stands motionless in the shallows, then spears fish with a lightning strike

rows.label: Bearded vulture
rows.hook: drops bones from great heights to crack them open and eat the marrow

rows.label: Barred owl
rows.hook: is famed for a hooting call that sounds like "who cooks for you"

rows.label: Sandhill crane
rows.hook: performs elaborate dancing displays and migrates in huge flocks

rows.label: Cockatiel
rows.hook: is a crested pet with orange cheek patches that whistles tunes

rows.label: Woodpecker
rows.hook: hammers on trunks with its beak to find insects and carve nests

rows.label: Muscovy duck
rows.hook: is a big, red-faced, waddling farm and pond bird native to Central and South America

rows.label: California condor
rows.hook: is North America's largest land bird, rescued from the brink of extinction by captive breeding

rows.label: Indian peafowl
rows.hook: is the showy one whose males fan out enormous eyespot-covered tail feathers

rows.label: Toucan
rows.hook: has an enormous colorful beak and lives in tropical forests of Central and South America

rows.label: Great tit
rows.hook: is a common European garden bird with a black stripe down its yellow chest

rows.label: Bird-of-paradise
rows.description: family of birds of the order Passeriformes
rows.hook: is a New Guinea forest dweller famed for dazzling plumes and elaborate courtship dances

rows.label: Cockatoo
rows.hook: is a crested parrot relative that raises and lowers its head plume when excited

rows.label: Atlantic puffin
rows.hook: has a bright orange beak and is nicknamed the clown of the sea

rows.label: Hornbill
rows.description: family of birds in the order Bucerotiformes
rows.hook: has a huge curved beak topped with a casque, found in Africa and Asia

rows.label: European robin
rows.hook: has an orange-red breast and is a classic symbol on Christmas cards

rows.label: Frigatebird
rows.hook: inflates a huge red throat pouch to attract mates and steals food from other seabirds

rows.label: Blackbird
rows.hook: sings at dusk in European gardens, the male having a bright orange beak

rows.label: Great egret
rows.hook: is a tall white wader with long plumes once prized for hats

rows.label: Magpie
rows.hook: is a black-and-white relative of crows, famous in folklore for stealing shiny things

rows.label: Starling
rows.hook: forms vast swirling flocks called murmurations and imitates other sounds

rows.label: Ostrich
rows.hook: is the world's largest and fastest-running bird and lays the biggest egg

rows.label: Snowy owl
rows.hook: is the white Arctic hunter that plays Hedwig in Harry Potter

rows.label: Wild turkey
rows.description: species of turkey native to North America
rows.hook: is the native ancestor of the one served at American Thanksgiving dinners

rows.label: Pileated woodpecker
rows.hook: is a crow-sized forest hammerer with a flaming red crest said to inspire a cartoon character

rows.label: African grey parrot
rows.hook: is among the best talkers, able to copy human speech and understand words

rows.label: Kea
rows.hook: is a mischievous alpine parrot that rips rubber from parked cars in New Zealand

rows.label: Mute swan
rows.hook: is a big white bird with an orange bill and a knob on top, named for being quieter than its relatives

rows.label: Little penguin
rows.hook: is the smallest of its kind in the world, a blue-feathered bird from Australia and New Zealand

rows.label: Carolina parakeet
rows.description: extinct species of North American parrot

rows.label: American robin
rows.hook: is a red-breasted thrush, named after a European look-alike, and the most abundant landbird in North America

rows.label: Stork
rows.description: family of birds; type of bird with long neck, long legs and a big beak
rows.hook: is a long-legged wader with a stout bill, folklore's bringer of newborn babies

rows.label: Black swan
rows.hook: is an all-dark bird with a red bill, native to Australia and a symbol of Western Australia

rows.label: American crow
rows.hook: is a glossy all-dark, highly intelligent bird common across North America, easily confused with the raven
